title: AE Services for Tri-Level Building Roof Replacement
short_description: Architectural and engineering services for replacing the roof system of a transportation maintenance building.
project_location: Detroit Maintenance Garage, 1500 E Ferry St., Detroit, Michigan 48211, USA
project_scope: Replacement of the existing roof system at the Tri-Level Building located at the Detroit Maintenance Garage. The notice states professional architectural and engineering services are required for project phases 100 through 700, but provides no technical data on roof area, spans, structural system, or building size.
services: Professional architectural and engineering services for phases 100 through 700; disciplines requested include architecture services, interior design/space planning, and rehabilitation/refurbishment.
relevance_explanation:
- Building roof replacement for a maintenance/administrative-type transportation facility, with no indication of structural innovation or long-span complexity.
- Tender is focused primarily on architectural and rehabilitation services rather than structural or bridge engineering.
- No technical characteristics suggesting a special structure, stadium, bridge, or architecturally demanding building.
- Limited fit with sbp core profile in lightweight, special, or complex load-bearing structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available information for a rough estimate is limited to: roof replacement at a tri-level building in Detroit, rehabilitation/refurbishment scope, and A/E services for phases 100 through 700. No roof area, building size, structural system, or cost benchmark is provided, so no realistic estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No design fee or budget is stated in the source. Because the construction budget, roof area, and scope detail are missing, no realistic fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Professional architectural and engineering services requested; disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, and rehabilitation/refurbishment. No explicit reference requirements or minimum qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
